info.title: PatrolTech Public API
info.description:
Public subset of the PatrolTech API. Breaking changes require a major version bump.

2.0.0: the request property `whatsappPhone` of `PATCH /api/auth/user/preferences` is
declared as what the API has always accepted (a string of 1 to 20 characters, or null);
it was declared as any value. Nullable response fields that hold a schema reference
(`pricing`, `usage`) are declared as `anyOf` plus `nullable`.

Response envelope for `/api/*`: every JSON response is wrapped as
`{ success, message, data, meta? }`. The 2xx schemas below describe `data`.
Errors arrive as `{ success: false, message, data: null, meta }`, with the details
(`errorCode`, `code`...) in `meta` unless the handler emitted the envelope itself.
`/oauth/*` and `/.well-known/*` follow the OAuth RFCs: plain JSON, no envelope.

Responses any `/api/*` operation can return, not repeated in each operation:
- 401: the operation needs a bearer token and it is missing, malformed, invalid
  (`meta.code: INVALID_TOKEN`), expired (`meta.code: TOKEN_EXPIRED`) or of a deleted
  account (`meta.errorCode: ACCOUNT_DELETED`). Get a new token and retry.
- 423: the organization the request targets (or all of the user’s organizations) is
  suspended. The body is the envelope with `data: { code: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED,
  organizationId, reason, scope, effectiveAt }`. Billing and account endpoints stay open.
- 451: on a write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), the user has policies pending acceptance;
  `meta.pending` lists them. Accept them in the dashboard and retry.
- 429: too many requests for that endpoint. Wait and retry.
- 500: unexpected server error. 502: a provider the operation depends on (payments)
  failed; the operations where it can happen document it.

parameters.description: `true` also lists the archived routes. By default they are left out.

400.description: Invalid request

post.summary: Add checkpoint to route

400.description: `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION`: the checkpoint is not on the route's location (or does not exist). `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` (`data.checkpointIds`): the checkpoint is archived.

delete.description: The rounds in progress on the route are cancelled. Removing its last checkpoint deactivates the route (`isActive: false`): an empty route cannot be patrolled. Adding checkpoints back does not reactivate it.

post.summary: Add time window to route
post.description:
**TIMEZONE CONTRACT**: `startTime`/`endTime` are UTC `HH:MM` and `days`
are ISO weekdays in UTC. The client converts local time → UTC before
sending; the backend never converts them.

Send `timezone` (IANA, e.g. "Europe/Madrid") with the zone the times
were converted from: the backend stores it with the current UTC offset
and re-projects the UTC times at every DST change so the window keeps
its local time. Without it the window is never realigned. If the route
already has a stored zone, that one wins and the window's `timezone` is
ignored.

400.description: The new window overlaps one the route already has: `code` is `TIME_WINDOWS_OVERLAP` and `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned when `timezone` is not a valid IANA zone, as a plain error whose `message` is `Invalid timezone: <zone>` (no `code`). Nothing is created.

delete.description: Needs EDITOR on the route's location (or in its organization). A route with a location also needs its organization linked to that location as `owner` or `provider`.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the route's location (nor in its organization), the route's organization is not linked to its location as `owner` or `provider`, or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never makes this write, even with the write scope

404.description: Time window not found, or its route no longer exists

get.summary: Get route with checkpoints and time windows

post.summary: Create route with checkpoints and time windows
post.description: Created active when it has checkpoints; without them (`checkpoints` empty or omitted) it is created inactive, whatever the body says: a route without checkpoints cannot be active.

400.description: Two of the submitted time windows overlap. Nothing is created; `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned, with `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION` and `data: null`, when a checkpoint is not on the route's location, and with `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` and `data.checkpointIds` when a checkpoint is archived.

409.description: `code: LOCATION_ARCHIVED`: the location is archived. Nothing is created; restore the location first.

get.summary: Get route rounds with pagination
Get the per-checkpoint scan breakdown for a route round
get.description:
Lists every checkpoint of the route (in route order) and whether it
was scanned during this specific round, with the scan time when it
was. Checkpoints are matched to scans by their POSITION in the route
(`order`), not by checkpoint id — a checkpoint can occupy more than
one slot in an ordered route.

patch.description: A route without checkpoints cannot be activated (400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`), nor an archived one (409 `ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: unarchive it first); deactivating it is always allowed.

400.description: `code: ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`: the route has no checkpoints and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

409.description: `code: ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: the route is archived and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

post.summary: Propose a batch of write actions awaiting confirmation
post.description: In one transaction it withdraws the still-`proposed` proposals of this user and contextKey (`expired` if they had already expired, `cancelled` if not) and stores the new batch with a new `batchId`, positions 0..n-1 and expiry now + ttlMin. A live proposal that the new batch repeats unchanged (same action, params, organization and idempotency key) is carried over: its copy in the new batch replaces it instead of it being cancelled, so a client that re-sends its pending batch plus one more action does not spend the daily quota twice. With a suspended organization the proposal is accepted (the user belongs to it); when it is executed, the real endpoint will answer 423. Proposals are scoped by the user and, for an agent token, by its OAuth client: another client of the same user never sees them. If the token's user no longer exists the answer is 401 with `meta.errorCode: USER_NOT_FOUND`.

201.description: The stored batch, in the proposed order

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST: invalid body (more than 10 actions, ttlMin outside 1..60, contextKey ending in whitespace…); or PARAMS_TOO_LARGE: the params of an action are over 16384 bytes. Nothing is stored

403.description: ORGANIZATION_NOT_ALLOWED: the user does not belong to the organization of an action; nothing is stored. Or USER_SESSION_REQUIRED: the token is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one); or insufficient_scope: an agent token with only the read scope cannot write

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: more than 30 batches per minute from this user; or PROPOSAL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: they already created 300 proposals in the last 24 hours (carried-over copies are not counted twice). Nothing is stored

post.summary: Claim a proposal to execute it (proposed → executing, atomic)
post.description: Of two simultaneous claims only one receives 200. An expired proposal that nobody had touched is marked `expired` here.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST: contextKey is missing or invalid

403.description: USER_SESSION_REQUIRED: the token is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one); or insufficient_scope: an agent token with only the read scope cannot write

404.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: it does not exist for this user, OAuth client and contextKey (or the id is not a UUID)

409.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_CLAIMABLE: already claimed, done, withdrawn or expired; data.status is the current status

post.summary: Mark a claimed proposal as executed, with its result
post.description: The action has already run, so the row always becomes `executed`, whatever the size of the result: a result over 16384 bytes is stored truncated as `{ truncated: true, preview }`, and a body over the HTTP limit (1 MB) as `{ truncated: true, preview: "", reason: "request_body_too_large" }`. It is never left `executing` (it could be reopened and executed twice). This is bookkeeping on the caller's own row, so it is exempt from the 423 and 451 walls. An `executing` action that nobody closes within an hour is closed automatically as `failed` with error `stale_executing`.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST: invalid body

403.description: USER_SESSION_REQUIRED: the token is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one); or insufficient_scope: an agent token with only the read scope cannot write

404.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: the id is not a UUID

409.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_EXECUTING: it is not `executing`, or it is not a proposal of this user and OAuth client: it is only closed from executing

post.summary: Mark a claimed proposal as failed, with its error
post.description: Bookkeeping on the caller's own row, so it is exempt from the 423 and 451 walls. A body over the HTTP limit (1 MB) closes it as `failed` with error "request body too large".

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST: the error field is missing or not a string

403.description: USER_SESSION_REQUIRED: the token is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one); or insufficient_scope: an agent token with only the read scope cannot write

404.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: the id is not a UUID

409.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_EXECUTING: it is not `executing`, or it is not a proposal of this user and OAuth client: it is only closed from executing

post.summary: Leave as proposals again the actions that have not been done yet
post.description: The user's actions that are `proposed`, or `executing` and claimed less than an hour ago, and belong to the latest batch of their contextKey go back to `proposed` with a renewed expiry. The rest are not touched: finished ones, ones from a batch older than the latest proposed, `executing` ones claimed over an hour ago (they may have run: they are closed as `failed` instead) and ids of another user or OAuth client. If the token's user no longer exists the answer is 401 with `meta.errorCode: USER_NOT_FOUND`.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST: no ids, more than 10 ids, an id that is not a UUID, or ttlMin outside 1..60

403.description: USER_SESSION_REQUIRED: the token is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one); or insufficient_scope: an agent token with only the read scope cannot write

get.summary: Get user preferences
get.description: The caller's own language, timezone and notification preferences. Change them with `updateUserPreferences`. A token that is not a user session (for instance, a patroller one) has no preferences: 404.

400.description: Invalid language code

403.description: meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_CHANGE_IDENTITY: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) does not change the account's phones (phone, whatsappPhone); only the user's own session does. Nothing was changed (only when the body carries whatsappPhone)

put.summary: Update the role type of an existing user role
put.description: Needs an organization-wide ADMIN role in the organization the role belongs to (for a location role, the organization of that location). Promoting a VIEWER to EDITOR or ADMIN takes a manager seat and goes through the plan limit (402).

400.description: Invalid role type

402.description: `code: USER_LIMIT_REACHED`: promoting a VIEWER to EDITOR or ADMIN would exceed the plan's `max_users`. The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. Nothing changes.

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization, or meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_GRANT_ACCESS: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never gives or changes a role, even with the write scope. Also when the role does not exist and the body does not name its organization (`Organization could not be resolved`): its organization cannot be resolved, so it is refused before looking further.

404.description: User role not found (only reachable when the body carries an `organizationId` the caller administers)

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description: Needs an organization-wide ADMIN role in the organization the role belongs to (for a location role, the organization of that location).

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization, the role does not exist (its organization cannot be resolved: `Organization could not be resolved`), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never makes this write, even with the write scope

404.description: User role not found (only reachable when the body carries an `organizationId` the caller administers)

get.summary: List organizations the authenticated user has access to
get.description: The organizations where the caller has a role (VIEWER or above), either on the organization or on one of its non-archived locations. Empty when there are none.

200.description: Organization map, keyed by organization id

get.summary: List users in an organization

403.description: No access to this organization

post.summary: Create a user and assign them to an organization
post.description: Needs an organization-wide ADMIN role in `organizationId`. A new email creates the account and sends it an invitation to set its password; an existing one only gets the role (and a notification). An EDITOR or ADMIN role takes a manager seat and goes through the plan limit (402); VIEWER never does.

200.description: Role assigned to an existing user

schema.description: Always null: the user is not returned. `meta.emailSent` (only for a new account) says whether the invitation email went out.
Always null: the user is not returned. `meta.emailSent` (only for a new account) says whether the invitation email went out.

400.description: Missing email, LOCATION role without locationId, or the person already has a role on that scope (or the new account is invalid, e.g. without `name`)

402.description: `code: USER_LIMIT_REACHED`: an EDITOR or ADMIN role would exceed the plan's `max_users`. The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. Nothing is created.

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization (also without `organizationId`: `Organization could not be resolved`), or locationId is not a location of this organization, or meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_GRANT_ACCESS: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never invites or assigns anyone, even with the write scope

409.description: meta.errorCode ACCOUNT_DELETED: the email belongs to a deleted account. The role is not assigned; the person has to contact support to recover it.

200.description: Aggregated support summary for the organization

400.description: Invalid windowDays

get.summary: List checkpoints for a location

400.description: Location ID is required

post.summary: Create a checkpoint

400.description: VERIFICATION_TYPE_RETIRED: the inline method is `manual_code`, which can no longer be created. Also VALIDATION_ERROR for a malformed body.

409.description: VERIFICATION_CODE_TAKEN: the chosen code is already used by a live checkpoint of the organization (body below). Also EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED on paid plans when the checkpoint adds a charge that needs confirming (`confirmExtraBilling`). LOCATION_ARCHIVED when its location is archived: nothing is created.

422.description: Invalid verificationMethod config for its type (e.g. a qr_static code over 1000 bytes) or a type not implemented yet

post.summary: Archive a checkpoint (history preserved; cannot be assigned to new rounds)
post.description: Takes the checkpoint off every route it was on (positions are closed up and the rounds in progress on those routes are cancelled). A route left without checkpoints is deactivated. `affectedRoutes` lists those routes.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the checkpoint location (nor in its organization), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never makes this write, even with the write scope

post.summary: Unarchive a checkpoint
post.description: For the plan, bringing a checkpoint back into the active count is the same as creating one: it goes through the same limit (402 at the Free cap) and is charged as an extra the same way (409 to confirm).

402.description: `code: CHECKPOINT_LIMIT_REACHED`: a Free plan at its checkpoint limit (unarchiving counts as creating one). The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. It stays archived.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the checkpoint location (nor in its organization), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) never makes this write, even with the write scope

409.description: Checkpoint is not archived, the extra charge needs confirming (EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED), or VERIFICATION_CODE_TAKEN when a live checkpoint of the organization took its code while it was archived (body below). LOCATION_ARCHIVED when its location is archived: restore the location first.

502.description: `code: BILLING_UPDATE_FAILED`: the confirmed extra charge could not be billed. Nothing was charged and it stays archived: retry.

post.summary: Create a one-hour link to the printable QR sheet of a location
post.description: The sheet holds one QR per finalized, non archived checkpoint with an active qr_static method, in creation order, 12 per A4 page. Each QR encodes the configured code (the checkpoint identifier when the code is empty or longer than 1,000 bytes); a checkpoint with nothing a scan would accept is left out. The PDF itself is not returned: open the link from `downloadQrSheet`.

400.description: Body does not match CreateQrSheetBody

403.description: The caller is not an EDITOR of the location (a role on an archived location does not count)

404.description: LOCATION_NOT_FOUND: no such location, or one without organization (errorCode in the response metadata)

422.description: NO_PRINTABLE_CHECKPOINTS: nothing to print; or QR_SHEET_TOO_LARGE: more than 600 printable checkpoints, send `checkpointIds` to print a subset (errorCode in the response metadata)

get.summary: Download the QR sheet PDF of a signed link
get.description: No Authorization header: the link is the credential. The sheet is rebuilt from the checkpoints as they are now, and the user the link was issued to must still be an active EDITOR of the location.

403.description: QR_SHEET_ACCESS_REVOKED: the user is no longer active or no longer an EDITOR of the location (errorCode in the response metadata)

410.description: QR_SHEET_LINK_INVALID: tampered, forged, expired, malformed or unknown link, always the same answer (errorCode in the response metadata)

422.description: NO_PRINTABLE_CHECKPOINTS: nothing printable is left; or QR_SHEET_TOO_LARGE: the location now has more than 600 printable checkpoints (errorCode in the response metadata)

423.description: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: the organization of the location is suspended. Same body as any other 423 (see the contract description); the link carries no session, so the suspension is checked here.

429.description: Too many downloads: 30 per minute per IP and 10 per minute per user; errorCode RATE_LIMITED

get.summary: Catalogue of the active plans with their per-checkpoint pricing
get.description: Public catalogue: no authentication required. Without a session, `organizationId` is ignored and prices come in the currency of the country (`country`, or the request's). With a session, the currency of `organizationId` is used only if the user belongs to that organization; otherwise it is ignored too, so it never reveals another organization's billing currency. If the request carries `Authorization`, the token must be valid (401 otherwise).

post.summary: Open a checkout with the payment provider for an organization that does not pay yet
post.description: The organization goes in the `organizationId` query parameter or in the `x-organization-id` header: one of them is required (400 ORGANIZATION_ID_REQUIRED otherwise) and, if both are sent, the query parameter wins. For compatibility, `organizationId` in the body is also accepted and takes precedence over both. ADMIN. Only for organizations without a live subscription: one that already pays changes plan from the dashboard. Creating the session charges nothing: payment happens on the provider's page and the plan is activated once paid. If the organization already has more checkpoints than the plan includes, the session also charges the extra ones.

400.description: ORGANIZATION_ID_REQUIRED, VALIDATION_ERROR or CHECKOUT_SESSION_FAILED (the plan is not a paid one, or neither the organization nor the user has a billing email)

403.description: ORGANIZATION_ACCESS_DENIED (no role in the organization) or INSUFFICIENT_ORGANIZATION_ROLE (not an ADMIN). AGENT_CANNOT_MANAGE_BILLING: an AI agent session (a token from `/oauth/agent-session`) does not manage billing (paying, changing plan, cancelling, resuming or opening the portal); only the user's own session does. Nothing was changed

The window is clamped to the plan's data retention (`retentionCutoff`). For a VIEWER under the patroller visibility policy, a hidden name comes as the organization's alias (or blank), a hidden identifier blank, and with the name hidden `patrollerId` comes null.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Times stay UTC; this records which local time they came from so the backend can re-project them when the offset changes (DST).

windows.description: The two conflicting windows (UTC), in the order they were checked.

scheduleTimezone.description: IANA timezone the route schedule is expressed in, chosen by the user. Takes precedence over the stored one and over each window timezone: only a client that converted the times with it sends this field.

expectedVersion.description: The `version` the client loaded. If stale, the update is rejected with 409 so a concurrent edit is never silently overwritten.

isActive.description: Update only (ignored on create: a new route is active when it has checkpoints). A route without checkpoints cannot be active: saved with an empty list it is deactivated, and activating one without sending checkpoints is refused with 400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`. Anything but a boolean is refused with 400.

RouteArchiveConflict.description: 409 of creating, updating, deleting, archiving, unarchiving or activating a route. `code` is at the top level; LOCATION_ARCHIVED means the location of the route, or the one an update assigns to a route without one, is archived.

contextKey.description: Key of the client's conversation or session. It only tells sessions of the same user apart; it never grants access to another user's proposals. It must not end with whitespace.

ttlMin.description: Minutes until it expires if not confirmed.

expiresAt.description: Expiry: creation + ttlMin, with millisecond precision.

contextKey.description: Key of the client's conversation or session. It only tells sessions of the same user apart; it never grants access to another user's proposals. It must not end with whitespace.

result.description: Result of the execution (JSON). If it exceeds 16384 bytes it is stored truncated as `{ truncated: true, preview }` (the start of its JSON) and the action still becomes `executed`: it is never left `executing`. A body over the HTTP limit (1 MB) is stored as `{ truncated: true, preview: "", reason: "request_body_too_large" }`.

error.description: Truncated to 1000 characters. An empty error is stored as "unknown error". A body over the HTTP limit (1 MB) is stored as "request body too large".

contextKey.description: Key of the client's conversation or session. It only tells sessions of the same user apart; it never grants access to another user's proposals. It must not end with whitespace.

channels.description: Per alert type, which channels are on (`{ <alertType>: { <channel>: boolean } }`). Empty when the user never changed an alert: the defaults apply.

globalChannels.description: Per channel, an override for every alert type (for instance, all email off). It cannot be set through this API, and it wins over `channels`.

notificationPreferences.description: null when the user has no notification preferences stored.

whatsappPhone.description: Phone number for WhatsApp notifications, 1 to 20 characters; null removes it. Omit it to leave the current one unchanged.

channels.description: Per alert type, which channels are on (`{ <alertType>: { <channel>: boolean } }`). Empty when the user never changed an alert: the defaults apply.

globalChannels.description: Per channel, an override for every alert type (for instance, all email off). It cannot be set through this API, and it wins over `channels`.

notificationPreferences.description: null when the user has no notification preferences stored.

type.description: One of security_company, homeowners_association, maintenance_company or other.

id.description: Ignored: the server always generates the id of a new user.

email.description: Matched case-insensitively against existing users; stored lower-cased.

roleType.description: Omitted (or not a role): VIEWER, least privilege. VIEWER does not use a manager seat of the plan.

locationId.description: Required when roleScope is LOCATION; must be a location of (or linked to) organizationId.

config.description: Per-type config. For `qr_static` and `manual_code`, `code` is a non-empty string; a `qr_static` code is printed as a QR, so it is at most 1000 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (longer is a config validation error).

leftEmpty.description: No checkpoint is left on the route.

deactivated.description: The route was active and archiving deactivated it for being left without checkpoints.

affectedRoutes.description: Routes the checkpoint was taken off (empty when it was on none). A route left without checkpoints is deactivated.

confirmExtraBilling.description: Accepts the charge of the extra checkpoint. Needed when the previous answer was 409 EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

checkpointIds.description: Print only these checkpoints. Ids of another location, archived, draft or non-QR checkpoints are skipped. Omit to print every printable checkpoint of the location.

url.description: Link to the PDF. It works without a session until `expiresAt`, but only while the user who requested it is still an active EDITOR of the location.

tierId.description: What to send to `createCheckoutSession` to subscribe to this plan.

price.description: Monthly base price in major units (not cents), in `currency`.

pricing.description: null for Free, or for an older plan that is no longer sold.

interval.description: Billing interval chosen by the user.

country.description: ISO-2 country confirmed in the plan selector. Ignored when the organization already has its currency fixed.

sessionUrl.description: The payment provider's checkout page. It expires after 45 minutes.

returnUrl.description: Where the user returns when leaving the payment provider's portal.

hasActiveSubscription.description: True when the organization already pays a live subscription with the payment provider (active, trialing or past due, including one set to cancel at period end), the same rule that makes checkout answer ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED. False for a free plan, a bonus, or a cancelled or expired subscription. Use it to offer subscription management instead of a new checkout.

address.description: `null` clears it (stored as an empty string).

UpdateLocationBody.description: Only name, address and city are applied; any other field is ignored.

identifier.description: What the guard app signs in with, unique across PatrolTech (at most 8 characters, the size of the column). Omitted: the server generates one (8 upper-case hex characters).

completionRate.description: Percent (0-100, rounded) of the checkpoints scanned out of all the checkpoints of the rounds of the patroller in the window; 0 without rounds. It is not the share of rounds completed (see `roundsCompleted`).

retentionCutoff.description: Earliest instant the plan's data retention lets the ranking count; null when unlimited.

completionRate.description: Percent (0-100, rounded) of the checkpoints scanned out of all the checkpoints of the rounds of the patroller in the window; 0 without rounds. It is not the share of rounds completed (see `roundsCompleted`).

retentionCutoff.description: Days of `scansByDay` before this instant are outside the plan's data retention; null when unlimited.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in, or null for windows created before it was recorded. Clients must edit the schedule in THIS timezone, not in the timezone of whoever opens the form: sending back a different one would re-label the route and shift it on the next DST change.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Offset in minutes applied when the local times were converted to UTC, or null. Recorded so the backend can re-project the window when the offset changes (DST).

isFirstRoute.description: Only on create. True when this is the first route of the organization, decided atomically server-side.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter. Send it back as `expectedVersion` on update.

archivedAt.description: When the route was archived because it has history; null while in use. An archived route is inactive and left out of lists unless `includeArchived=true`.

params.description: Parameters of the action: must be a JSON object (not an array or a bare value). Its JSON is at most 16384 bytes (400 PARAMS_TOO_LARGE).

organizationId.description: Organization the action affects. If given, the user must belong to it (any role); otherwise 403 ORGANIZATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

includedCheckpoints.description: Checkpoints included in the base price.

extra.description: Cost of EACH checkpoint above the included ones.

yearly.description: Yearly amounts, already multiplied. Derived from the monthly ones, like the yearly prices that are actually charged.

monthsBilledYearly.description: Months paid when choosing yearly billing (12 minus this = free months).

oauthAccessToken.description: OAuth access token issued by POST /oauth/token
